name: Static Memory
detailed_description:
ABOUT THE GAME

In Static Memory, you play as Haruto (陽翔), a 28-year-old news reporter. Haruto is trying to solve the mystery of his sister Shizuka’s death. She died 9 years ago, and no one ever found out how or why.

Now, Haruto hires a Special Investigation Team to finally discover the truth.

To help his family move on, Haruto takes them to a quiet, beautiful mansion far from the city. It feels like a new start—until strange things begin to happen.

One day, Haruto’s father puts Shizuka’s photo into a frame on the wall. After that, everything changes. Strange sounds come from the rooftop at 3 AM. Doors open by themselves. The house feels different.

Then Haruto’s father dies.

It looks like suicide. But Haruto doesn’t believe it. He tells the team: “First, solve my father’s case. I think his death and Shizuka’s are connected.”

Now, the mansion is full of secrets. Hidden memories, strange events, and painful pasts all come to the surface. Haruto must face the truth—no matter how dark it is.

                                  

KEY FEATURES

📖 Story-Rich Experience
Play through a deep and emotional story about family, memory, and mystery. Discover secrets one by one as the truth slowly comes out.

🏠 Explore the Mansion
Walk through the mansion’s dark halls, secret rooms, and quiet corners. Look for old letters, journals, video tapes, and clues.

🕵️ Solve the Mystery
Use tools to find clues, study strange photos, and learn from witness interviews. Pay close attention to every small detail.

🧠 Psychological Horror
This is not about jump scares. This is about slow, scary tension. What’s real? What’s memory? What’s being hidden?

💬 Emotional Choices
Talk to your family. Choose what to tell them—and what to hide. Every choice changes your relationships.

⏳ Travel Through Time
See the past through old photos, VHS tapes, and memories. Play scenes from different times and different people. The past is alive.

MAIN CHARACTERS

  • Haruto (陽翔) – A reporter looking for answers about his family’s past.

  • Shizuka – Haruto’s sister. Her mysterious death changed everything.

  • Father – A man who tried to find peace but may have known too much.

  • Mother – Struggling with her emotions, trying to stay strong.

  • Younger Brother – Curious and quiet. He may have seen things others missed.

  • Investigation Team – Experts trying to connect two deaths and discover what’s really going on in the mansion.

A NOTE FROM THE CREATORS

Static Memory is more than a horror game. It’s a story about family, pain, and the search for truth. Sometimes silence is scarier than sounds. Sometimes the scariest thing is what we find in our own past.

Will you find the truth? Or will the past swallow you too?

READY TO BEGIN?

Add Static Memory to your wishlist and get ready to uncover what was forgotten.

short_description: Haruto, a 28-year-old reporter, hires a special team to solve his sister’s death from 9 years ago. But after his father dies mysteriously, he suspects both cases are connected. Explore a haunted mansion, uncover the truth, and face the past in Static Memory.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game features psychological horror, emotional and unsettling themes, and a storyline that includes references to suicide. It does not contain any sexual content, drug or alcohol use, or depictions of self-harm. Player discretion is advised, especially for those sensitive to dark or emotionally intense subject matter.
